light.hueSource: Saturation-weighted circular mean hue of the artwork sampled at 16×16. Falls back to a hash of the track id into the brand hues [14, 24, 34, 336, 348, 6, 318].
light.layerTechnique: Absolutely placed ellipses with radial-gradient(closest-side, ...) fading to transparent at their own edge, mix-blend-mode: screen; grain is SVG fractalNoise at 0.32 opacity in soft-light.

motion.purpose: The light (and glass tint) moving to a new track's hue.

motion.name: breathe
motion.value: violet 9s, magenta 7s, orange 6s, core-pulse 3.2s; infinite ease-in-out

components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 48px minmax(0,1fr) auto 44px; align-items: center; column-gap: 14px; padding: 8px 4px 8px 8px; border-radius: 14px; font-family: Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #F4EFFF; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-row:active { background: rgba(236,228,255,0.055); } .ds-cover { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 10px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 34% 30%, hsl(44 100% 88%) 0 8%, hsl(24 92% 60%) 36%, hsl(354 72% 50%) 64%, hsl(262 66% 38%) 100%); } .ds-meta { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; } .ds-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-sub { font-size: 14px; color: rgba(244,239,255,0.66); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-time { font-size: 14px; color: rgba(244,239,255,0.52); } .ds-more { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: none; color: rgba(244,239,255,0.66); cursor: pointer; } .ds-more:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFE3B8; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-row-playing .ds-title { color: #FFCB85; }

narrative.overview:
Нотка is a dark room with one light source in it, and that light is the music. A soft orb of layered ellipses, cream at the core, then orange, magenta and violet, floats behind every screen. At rest it is still and slightly dimmed. When a track plays it breathes, and over 1.4 seconds it shifts to a hue sampled from that track's artwork. Everything else stays quiet. The chrome is neutral white and lavender-grey on a near-black violet ground, there is one white pill for the primary action, and gold appears only on whatever is playing now.

The light is the only thing on screen allowed to carry color. Each screen places it differently: large and high on Home, low and big behind the onboarding copy, huge behind the Player, smaller and dimmer on Search and «Моё», and pushed up and faint on sub-screens. The bright crescent rims only show where the light is the subject (Home, onboarding, Player). A soft-light grain keeps the dark from banding, and a violet spill pools under the dock so the glass there has light to refract.

Liquid glass is a material you earn by floating over the light. The tab bar, the mini-player and the Player's round controls are clear and bright, with a specular rim and a faint tint of the current hue. Nothing else uses glass. Onest carries all the type: set large and tight at the top of the hierarchy, calm at 16px in rows, with tabular digits everywhere.
keyCharacteristics: One light source behind every screen. Its hue follows the playing track, and it breathes only while music plays.
Neutral chrome: white, lavender-grey and a single white primary pill per screen.
Gold (`now`) is reserved for the thing that is playing.
Liquid glass only on the dock and the Player's round controls.
Onest throughout, with tight negative tracking on headings and tabular numerals.
Covers at one registered scale. A missing cover shows a small piece of the light.

rules.name: The Only-Light-Is-Color Rule
rules.body: Chrome (text, icons, buttons, fields, borders, chips, tabs) is neutral. Color appears only as emitted light: the orb, the dock spill, glass tint, fallback covers, the «Мой микс» and empty-state orbs, the loading dots and the logo's core. The only exceptions are `now`, `liked` and `danger`, each tied to one meaning.

rules.name: The Now-Is-Gold Rule
rules.body: `now` marks the currently playing item and nothing else. It is not used for selection, confirmation or emphasis.

rules.name: The One-White-Pill Rule
rules.body: Each screen has at most one white `button-primary` pill. White round play discs (`round-light`) are the play affordance and do not count as the screen's pill, but they never appear in any other color.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` is set on body, so every duration, index and count aligns. Never turn it off locally.

rules.name: The Tight-Top Rule
rules.body: Anything 20px or larger is weight 700–800 with negative tracking between -0.02em and -0.035em. Anything 16px or smaller keeps tracking between -0.01em and 0.

rules.name: The Glass-Over-Light Rule
rules.body: Liquid glass (clear gradient fill tinted by `--c-warm` and `--c-deep`, `backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(190%) brightness(1.08)`, a 1px masked specular rim that is brightest at the top left, and a radial touch bloom at the finger position) is used only on the tab bar, the mini-player and the Player's round controls. It must look clear and bright. A grey film means it is wrong. Where blur is unsupported, it falls back to opaque `rgba(38, 32, 50, 0.92)`.

rules.name: The Rims-Where-Light-Leads Rule
rules.body: The orb's two crescent rims are visible only on Home, onboarding and Player. Everywhere else they fade to 0 over 0.9s.

dos: **Do** let the light carry all color. Feed it the artwork hue through `--c-core`, `--c-warm` and `--c-mid`, and transition over 1.4s.
**Do** give every screen its own light placement, and keep the rims to Home, onboarding and Player.
**Do** keep one white `button-primary` pill per screen and make every play affordance a white disc.
**Do** keep track rows on the strict grid (cover, title/artist, time, one action), and open the same menu on long-press as on «…».
**Do** use only registered cover sizes (44/48/56/150/220), and show a piece of the light when artwork is missing.
**Do** draw outlines and dividers as inset 1px `line` shadows.
**Do** set every number in tabular figures and every heading of 20px or more with negative tracking.
donts: **Don't** color chrome with the light stops or an accent. Buttons, chips, tabs, icons and switches stay white, lavender-grey or `surface`.
**Don't** use `now` gold for anything except what is currently playing.
**Don't** put liquid glass on surfaces that don't float over the light (content cards, grouped lists, sheets, modals), and never let it read as a grey film.
**Don't** make the orb breathe when nothing is playing.
**Don't** add a second track-row action, or cover sizes between the registered steps.
**Don't** give the logo a flat fill or tie its gradient to the track hue. Its head is always the brand light.
**Don't** set labels in uppercase or add kicker/eyebrow lines above headings.
